name: mkdirat
synopsis: int mkdirat(int dirfd, const char *pathname, mode_t mode);
description: The mkdirat() system call creates a new directory with the specified mode, similar to mkdir(), but interprets relative paths relative to a given directory file descriptor. It allows for more flexible path resolution, especially in scenarios requiring directory traversal from a specific file descriptor.

parameters.name: dirfd
parameters.description: Directory file descriptor; AT_FDCWD for current working directory

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Pathname of the new directory to create

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Mode for the new directory, modified by the process's umask

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set
